name: nd-cse-degree-audit
description: ND CSE Degree Requirement Progress Checking — static self-check audit against the CSE Graduate Studies Handbook §3 (MSCSE) and §4 (Ph.D.)
//scripts-note: Two path quirks, both because a parent folder of this repo has a ':' in its name (FY26-27 (DGS: Taeho Jung)): (1) binaries are invoked by relative path, since the colon corrupts the PATH npm builds for scripts; (2) tests run on node's built-in runner (node --test, native TypeScript), because vitest/vite-node cannot load modules from a node_modules under a colon path. Vite still does the production build.
